Faculty of Applied and Creative Arts.

This research is carried out towards the implementation of computer literacy the Art syllabus for Form 4 and 5 students. With the development of the post modern in the field of information technology it has become crucial for education to be dominated by computer technology. To achieve this aim, a survey has been carried out among art teachers to gauge their level of computer knowledge. Questions, which cover the study of attitudes, relationships, knowledge, responsibility and teachers' efforts toward computer knowledge, have been analysed using the descriptive method. This study also highlights the transformational challenges, beginning with the traditional educational approaches to that which employ the computer.

Essays in environment and development economics /

This thesis is a collection of essays all within the subject matter of environment and development economics. They fall within two main topics of this field: The last three essays deal with the micro-level incentives of inhabitants in poor run areas of developing countries for conservation of environmental resources. The first three essays take on a much more global approach, in that they deal with distributional issues (intra-or inter-generational) involved in the financing of large-scale environmental programmes, such as programmes intended to curtain or adapt to global climate change, and environmentally related aid projects offered to less developed countries.

An assessement of prior medical care and education received about asthma of patients presenting with acute asthma requiring nebulizer at the emergency department, University of Malaya Medical Centre /

The results of this survey revealed that the long term management for the asthmatic patients who presented to the emergency department of University Malaya Medical Centre were sub-optimal. It is essential that the emergency department should have a protocol on asthma management so that patients are adequately educated on the disease and adequate follow up I instituted for all patients.
A digestive phospholipase A2, and prostaglandin biosynthesis in the myiasis-causing screwworm, cochliomyia hominivorax /

This dissertation reports on my research into the metabolism of arachidonic acid in certain insects. Arachidonic acid is a polyunsaturated fatty acid that is thought to have two major functions (Dadd, 1983). First, arachidonic acid serves as a component of phospholipids it functions as a structural component of biological membranes. Second, arachidonic acid serves as substrate for the biosynthesis of prostaglandins are related compounds, collectively known as eicosanoids.
